title: Candlestick chart
intent: Show daily open, high, low, and close values with a full-range wick and direction-colored body.

ai.create: Create a responsive candlestick chart from typed OHLC rows using a low-to-high wick and a thicker open-to-close body colored by direction.
ai.maintain: Add a neutral color for unchanged sessions while preserving all 60 interval segments, date identity, and typed endpoint channels.
